name: LayerContentE
declaration:
enum LayerContentE {
  /**
   bit 0  ：源名称
   bit 1  ：源类型
   bit 2  : 源分辨率
   bit 3  ：源在AUX屏幕中使用时,显示AUX标识
   bit 4  ：源为屏幕时,该屏幕被FTB,则显示FTB
   bit 5  ：源为屏幕时,该屏幕被FREEZE,则显示FREEZE
   */
  name,
  type,
  resolution,
  aux,
  ftb,
  freeze,
  resolutionAndftb = 6,
  auxAndFtbAndFreeze = 56,
}
